# Kapture

> Kapture is two products. Kapture for Chrome captures a complete webpage, or a
> selected area of one, and saves it on the user's own device as a PNG, JPEG or PDF.
> Kapture Pro organises those captures into a searchable local library on the desktop,
> with Projects, Collections and a Smart workspace that keeps the library in order.

Kapture runs in Chrome's side panel. In full page mode it scrolls the whole
document rather than capturing only the visible viewport, splitting very long
pages into sections of up to 8,000 image rows. In select area mode the user
drags over the visible page, with Freeform, 1:1, 16:9 and 9:16 ratios.

Files are saved through Chrome's own Downloads system, into a Downloads
subfolder the user names per capture, so different pages or projects can be kept
in different folders. Kapture keeps a local capture history, split into Kept and
Deleted, and offers light and dark side panel themes. Settings holds the language
choice and a link to Help.

Both products are available in English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Korean and
Japanese, and both can follow the system language instead.

Kapture for Chrome requires Google Chrome 120 or later and is free. Kapture Pro is a
companion desktop app that indexes the screenshots already saved on the user's
computer and turns them into a searchable visual library. Its Library holds All
Captures, Recents, Favorites, Desktop Screenshots, Smart and Collections, with
Projects alongside it. Smart is a single workspace with five tools: Unorganised,
Duplicates, Cleanup, Sources and Rules. It never deletes anything for the user. Kapture Pro is not yet available to buy. It is planned for Mac and for
Windows, and the Windows build has not been released.

## Privacy

Screenshots, webpage content, URLs and history metadata are not sent to the
developer or to external servers. Kapture contains no analytics, advertising or
tracking, requires no account, and downloads no remote code.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kaptapp.com/): what Kapture is, the two capture modes, formats, viewport presets, folders, history, themes, Smart and languages.
- [Help](https://kaptapp.com/help/): how to use Kapture, permissions and release notes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kaptapp.com/privacy/): what information Kapture handles, how it is stored locally, and what is never transmitted.
